args.code:
"""pptx plugin: make_deck + check_deck tools built on the lessons in
.agents/skills/pptx/SKILL.md (grid, verified palette, WCAG contrast,
overflow estimation, footer zone).

make_deck spec (JSON string or object):
{
  "out": "deck-lab/mydeck.pptx",        # required
  "title": "Deck Title",                # shown in footers
  "theme": {"font": "Liberation Sans", "palette overrides..."},
  "slides": [
     {"kind": "title"|"cards"|"process"|"compare"|"chart"|"takeaway"|"closing",
      "kicker": "...", "heading": "...", "subtitle": "...",
      "items": [...] , "data": [{"label","value","note","frac"}],
      "left": {...}, "right": {...}, "band": "...", "page": n}
  ]
}
Layouts (16:9, 0.5in margins, content top 1.95in, footer zone >= 7.0in):
 - title/closing: dark slide, 44pt heading in a 2.0in box, rule bar
 - cards: N equal panels; big stat + caps label + 2-3 line description
 - process: numbered step rows (panel per step) + accent bold lead-in
 - compare: two panels with arrow between + dark takeaway band
 - chart: hand-rolled bars (rectangles), values inside tall bars / above short ones
"""
import json
import math
import os

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

# ---- verified palette (from skill) ----
DARK = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x2A, 0x44)
INK = RGBColor(0x2E, 0x34, 0x40)
MUTED = RGBColor(0x4A, 0x52, 0x60)
ACCENT = RGBColor(0xB5, 0x45, 0x0D)
ACCENT_L = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xB0, 0x7A)
SOFT = RGBColor(0xF4, 0xF6, 0xFA)
LINE = RGBColor(0xD8, 0xDE, 0xE9)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
FAINT = RGBColor(0xA8, 0xB4, 0xC8)
GRAY3 = RGBColor(0x6E, 0x78, 0x8C)
FONT = "Liberation Sans"
CW, CH = Inches(13.333), Inches(7.5)
CONTENT_TOP = 1.95
FOOTER_TOP = 7.0
EMU_IN = 914400


def _in(v):
    return float(v) / EMU_IN


# ---------- primitives ----------
def _blank(prs, bg=WHITE):
    s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    s.background.fill.solid()
    s.background.fill.fore_color.rgb = bg
    return s


def _text(slide, x, y, w, h, run, size, color=INK, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
          anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP, bold=False, line=1.15):
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    tf.margin_left = tf.margin_right = tf.margin_top = tf.margin_bottom = 0
    paras = [run] if isinstance(run, str) else run
    first = True
    for p in paras:
        para = tf.paragraphs[0] if first else tf.add_paragraph()
        first = False
        para.alignment = align
        para.line_spacing = line
        if isinstance(p, str):
            segs = [(p, {})]
        elif isinstance(p, dict) and "segs" in p:
            segs, extra = p["segs"], p
            para.alignment = extra.get("align", align)
            para.space_after = Pt(extra.get("space_after", 0))
            para.space_before = Pt(extra.get("space_before", 0))
        else:
            segs = p
        for t, ov in segs:
            r = para.add_run()
            r.text = t
            r.font.name = ov.get("font", FONT)
            r.font.size = Pt(ov.get("size", size))
            r.font.bold = ov.get("bold", bold)
            r.font.color.rgb = ov.get("color", color)
    return box


def _panel(slide, x, y, w, h, fill=SOFT, line_color=LINE):
    shp = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, x, y, w, h)
    shp.fill.solid()
    shp.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill
    if line_color:
        shp.line.color.rgb = line_color
        shp.line.width = Pt(0.75)
    else:
        shp.line.fill.background()
    try:
        shp.adjustments[0] = 0.08
    except Exception:
        pass
    shp.shadow.inherit = False
    return shp


def _rule(slide, x, y, w, color=ACCENT, h=0.07):
    bar = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, x, y, Inches(w), Inches(h))
    bar.fill.solid()
    bar.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    bar.line.fill.background()
    bar.shadow.inherit = False
    return bar


def _title_bar(slide, kicker, heading):
    _text(slide, Inches(0.5), Inches(0.42), Inches(9), Inches(0.35),
          kicker.upper(), 13, color=INK, bold=True)
    _text(slide, Inches(0.5), Inches(0.75), Inches(10), Inches(0.9),
          heading, 28, color=DARK, bold=True)
    _rule(slide, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.55), 1.6)
    return Inches(CONTENT_TOP)


def _footer(slide, deck_title, page):
    _text(slide, Inches(0.5), Inches(7.05), Inches(6), Inches(0.3),
          deck_title, 10, color=MUTED)
    _text(slide, Inches(12.0), Inches(7.05), Inches(0.8), Inches(0.3),
          str(page), 10, color=MUTED, align=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)


# ---------- slide builders ----------
def _slide_title(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs, DARK)
    _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(1.6), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.5),
          (spec.get("kicker") or "MINI-DECK").upper(), 15, color=ACCENT_L, bold=True)
    _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(2.0), Inches(11.5), Inches(2.0),
          spec.get("heading", "Untitled"), 44, color=WHITE, bold=True)
    if spec.get("subtitle"):
        _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(4.1), Inches(8.5), Inches(1.2),
               spec["subtitle"], 18, color=FAINT, line=1.35)
    _rule(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(5.6), 2.2, color=ACCENT_L)
    if spec.get("foot"):
        _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(5.1), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.5),
               spec["foot"], 14, color=FAINT)


def _slide_closing(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs, DARK)
    _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(2.2), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.85),
          spec.get("heading", "Remember this"), 44, color=WHITE, bold=True)
    _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(3.4), Inches(10.5), Inches(1.0),
          spec.get("subtitle", ""), 18, color=FAINT, line=1.4)
    _rule(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(4.75), 2.2, color=ACCENT_L)
    if spec.get("foot"):
        _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(5.1), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.5),
               spec["foot"], 14, color=FAINT)


def _slide_cards(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs)
    top = _title_bar(s, spec.get("kicker", "Overview"), spec.get("heading", ""))
    items = spec.get("items", [])
    n = max(1, len(items))
    gap = 0.31
    total_w = 10.3
    cw_ = (total_w - (n - 1) * gap) / n
    x0 = 0.5
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        x = x0 + i * (cw_ + gap)
        _panel(s, Inches(x), top + Inches(0.15), Inches(cw_), Inches(3.7))
        if it.get("stat"):
            _text(s, Inches(x + 0.25), top + Inches(0.5), Inches(cw_ - 0.5), Inches(0.5),
                  it["stat"], 28, color=ACCENT, bold=True)
            _text(s, Inches(x + 0.25), top + Inches(1.15), Inches(cw_ - 0.5), Inches(0.5),
                  (it.get("label") or "").upper(), 13, color=INK, bold=True)
            dy = 1.9
        else:
            _text(s, Inches(x + 0.25), top + Inches(0.5), Inches(cw_ - 0.5), Inches(0.5),
                  it.get("label", ""), 20, color=DARK, bold=True)
            dy = 1.1
        if it.get("desc"):
            _text(s, Inches(x + 0.25), top + Inches(dy), Inches(cw_ - 0.5), Inches(1.8),
                  it["desc"], 13.5, color=MUTED, line=1.3)
    _footer(s, deck_title, page)


def _slide_process(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs)
    top = _title_bar(s, spec.get("kicker", "Process"), spec.get("heading", ""))
    items = spec.get("items", [])
    n = max(1, len(items))
    step_h = min(1.25, 4.4 / n)
    step_gap = 0.18
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        y = top + 0.15 + i * (step_h + step_gap)
        _panel(s, Inches(0.5), Inches(y), Inches(10.3), Inches(step_h))
        _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(y + 0.18), Inches(2.6), Inches(0.6),
              f"{i + 1}.  {it.get('label', '')}", 17, color=DARK, bold=True)
        if it.get("desc"):
            _text(s, Inches(3.7), Inches(y + 0.22), Inches(6.8), Inches(0.65),
                  it["desc"], 13.5, color=INK, line=1.25)
    if spec.get("band"):
        yb = top + 0.15 + n * step_h + (n) * step_gap + 0.15
        _text(s, Inches(0.5), Inches(yb), Inches(10.3), Inches(0.55),
              [
                  {"segs": [(spec["band"].split("::")[0], {"bold": True, "color": ACCENT}),
                             ("::" if "::" in spec["band"] else "", {"color": INK}),
                             (spec["band"].split("::", 1)[1] if "::" in spec["band"] else "", {"color": INK})]},
              ], 15, line=1.3)
    _footer(s, deck_title, page)


def _slide_compare(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs)
    top = _title_bar(s, spec.get("kicker", "Compare"), spec.get("heading", ""))
    left = spec.get("left", {})
    right = spec.get("right", {})
    for side, panel_x in ((left, 0.5), (right, 5.9)):
        _panel(s, Inches(panel_x), top + Inches(0.1), Inches(4.9), Inches(3.6), fill=SOFT)
        _text(s, Inches(panel_x + 0.35), top + Inches(0.45), Inches(4.2), Inches(0.5),
               side.get("label", ""), 18, color=DARK, bold=True)
        paras = []
        for d in side.get("descs", []):
            paras.append({"segs": [(d, {"color": INK})], "space_after": 8})
        if paras:
            _text(s, Inches(panel_x + 0.35), top + Inches(1.0), Inches(4.2), Inches(2.4),
                  paras, 14, line=1.35)
    arrow = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RIGHT_ARROW, Inches(5.42), top + Inches(1.6),
                               Inches(0.5), Inches(0.7))
    arrow.fill.solid()
    arrow.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT
    arrow.line.fill.background()
    arrow.shadow.inherit = False
    if spec.get("band"):
        band = _panel(s, Inches(0.5), top + Inches(3.95), Inches(10.3), Inches(0.75), fill=DARK)
        _text(s, Inches(0.85), top + Inches(4.12), Inches(9.6), Inches(0.55),
               spec["band"], 15, color=WHITE, bold=True, anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE)
    _footer(s, deck_title, page)


def _slide_chart(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs)
    top = _title_bar(s, spec.get("kicker", "Data"), spec.get("heading", ""))
    cx0, cy0, pw, ph = 0.9, top + 0.45, 6.6, 3.5
    _panel(s, Inches(cx0 - 0.3), Inches(cy0 - 0.35), Inches(pw + 0.6), Inches(ph + 0.7))
    _text(s, Inches(cx0 - 0.1), Inches(cy0 - 0.28), Inches(pw), Inches(0.3),
          spec.get("chart_title", "Values"), 11, color=INK)
    axis = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(cx0), Inches(cy0 + ph),
                              Inches(pw), Pt(1.5))
    axis.fill.solid()
    axis.fill.fore_color.rgb = MUTED
    axis.line.fill.background()
    axis.shadow.inherit = False
    data = spec.get("data", [])
    n = max(1, len(data))
    bw, gap = (pw / n) * 0.68, (pw / n) * 0.32
    for i, d in enumerate(data):
        frac = max(0.05, min(0.9, float(d.get("frac", 0.5))))
        bh = int(ph * frac * 914400)
        x = cx0 + i * (bw + gap)
        b = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(x), Inches(cy0 + ph - bh / 914400),
                               Inches(bw), Emu(bh))
        b.fill.solid()
        b.fill.fore_color.rgb = DARK if frac >= 0.5 else (ACCENT if frac < 0.5 and i % 2 == 1 else GRAY3)
        b.line.fill.background()
        b.shadow.inherit = False
        val = str(d.get("value", ""))
        if bh >= Inches(0.55):
            _text(s, Inches(x), Inches(cy0 + ph - bh / 914400 + 0.08), Inches(bw), Inches(0.4),
                  val, 14, color=WHITE, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        else:
            _text(s, Inches(x), Inches(cy0 + ph - bh / 914400 - 0.4), Inches(bw), Inches(0.4),
                  val, 14, color=INK, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        _text(s, Inches(x), Inches(cy0 + ph + 0.08), Inches(bw), Inches(0.4),
               d.get("label", ""), 12, color=MUTED, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    if spec.get("caption"):
        _text(s, Inches(cx0), Inches(cy0 + ph + 0.62), Inches(pw), Inches(0.35),
               spec["caption"], 11, color=MUTED)
    # right panel
    _panel(s, Inches(8.1), top + Inches(0.1), Inches(4.7), Inches(3.6), fill=SOFT)
    _text(s, Inches(8.4), top + Inches(0.4), Inches(4.1), Inches(0.5),
          spec.get("note_label", "Read the data"), 18, color=DARK, bold=True)
    tips = spec.get("notes", [])
    yy = top + 1.05
    for t in tips[:3]:
        dot = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.OVAL, Inches(8.45), Inches(yy + 0.08),
                                 Inches(0.14), Inches(0.14))
        dot.fill.solid()
        dot.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT
        dot.line.fill.background()
        dot.shadow.inherit = False
        _text(s, Inches(8.75), Inches(yy), Inches(3.9), Inches(0.6), t, 13, color=INK, line=1.2)
        yy += 0.75
    _footer(s, deck_title, page)


def _slide_takeaway(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs)
    top = _title_bar(s, spec.get("kicker", "Key point"), spec.get("heading", ""))
    band = _panel(s, Inches(0.5), top + Inches(0.3), Inches(10.3), Inches(1.1), fill=DARK)
    _text(s, Inches(0.85), top + Inches(0.45), Inches(9.6), Inches(0.8),
          spec.get("band", spec.get("subtitle", "")), 16, color=WHITE, bold=True,
          anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE, line=1.3)
    if spec.get("points"):
        yy = top + 1.75
        for p in spec["points"]:
            dot = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.OVAL, Inches(0.9), Inches(yy + 0.08),
                                     Inches(0.14), Inches(0.14))
            dot.fill.solid()
            dot.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT
            dot.line.fill.background()
            dot.shadow.inherit = False
            _text(s, Inches(1.25), Inches(yy), Inches(9.4), Inches(0.5), p, 14, color=INK, line=1.2)
            yy += 0.6
    _footer(s, deck_title, page)


BUILDERS = {
    "title": _slide_title,
    "closing": _slide_closing,
    "cards": _slide_cards,
    "process": _slide_process,
    "compare": _slide_compare,
    "chart": _slide_chart,
    "takeaway": _slide_takeaway,
}


# ---------- tool: make_deck ----------
def make_deck(session, args):
    spec = args if isinstance(args, dict) else json.loads(args)
    out = spec.get("out") or "deck-lab/unnamed.pptx"
    deck_title = spec.get("title", out)
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height = CW, CH
    for i, s in enumerate(spec.get("slides", []), 1):
        kind = s.get("kind", "cards")
        page = s.get("page", i if kind not in ("title", "closing") else None)
        if kind in ("title", "closing"):
            BUILDERS[kind](prs, s, deck_title, i)
        elif page:
            BUILDERS.get(kind, _slide_cards)(prs, s, deck_title, page)
        else:
            BUILDERS.get(kind, _slide_cards)(prs, s, deck_title, i)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out) or ".", exist_ok=True)
    prs.save(out)
    return f"saved {out} with {len(prs.slides._sldIdLst)} slides"


# ---------- tool: check_deck ----------
AVG_CHAR_PT = 0.55
LINE_H = 1.35


def _est_lines(text, box_w_in, size_pt):
    if not text:
        return 0
    cpl = max(1, int(box_w_in * 72 / (size_pt * AVG_CHAR_PT)))
    lines = 0
    for raw in text.split("\n"):
        lines += max(1, -(-len(raw) // cpl)) if len(raw) > 0.95 * cpl else 1
    return lines


def _lum(r, g, b):
    def f(c):
        c /= 255
        return c / 12.92 if c <= 0.04045 else ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4
    R, G, B = f(r), f(g), f(b)
    return 0.2126 * R + 0.7152 * G + 0.0722 * B


def check_deck(session, args):
    path = args if isinstance(args, str) else args.get("path")
    min_font = 10
    prs = Presentation(path)
    sw, sh = _in(prs.slide_width), _in(prs.slide_height)
    problems = []
    for idx, slide in enumerate(prs.slides, 1):
        bg = None
        try:
            f = slide.background.fill
            if f.type is not None and f.type == 1:
                bg = f.fore_color.rgb
        except Exception:
            pass
        shapes = list(slide.shapes)
        for shape in shapes:
            x, y, w, h = _in(shape.left), _in(shape.top), _in(shape.width), _in(shape.height)
            if not shape.has_text_frame:
                continue
            tf = shape.text_frame
            text = tf.text
            if not text.strip():
                continue
            if x < -0.01 or y < -0.01 or x + w > sw + 0.01 or y + h > sh + 0.01:
                problems.append(f"slide {idx}: out of bounds '{text[:30]}'")
            is_footer = y >= FOOTER_TOP - 0.05 and len(text) < 60
            if not is_footer and y + h > FOOTER_TOP:
                problems.append(f"slide {idx}: crosses footer '{text[:30]}' (bottom {y + h:.2f})")
            # shape-vs-shape overlap among textboxes
            for other in shapes:
                if other is shape or not other.has_text_frame:
                    continue
                ox, oy = _in(other.left), _in(other.top)
                ow, oh = _in(other.width), _in(other.height)
                # only flag if both are "body" textboxes that meaningfully intersect
                if ox < x + w and ox + ow > x and oy < y + h and oy + oh > y:
                    ix = max(0.0, min(x + w, ox + ow) - max(x, ox))
                    iy = max(0.0, min(y + h, oy + oh) - max(y, oy))
                    if ix > 0.15 and iy > 0.15:
                        problems.append(f"slide {idx}: overlap '{text[:20]}' x '{other.text_frame.text[:20]}'")
            for para in tf.paragraphs:
                if not para.text.strip():
                    continue
                ptxt = para.text
                psize = None
                pcolor = None
                for r in para.runs:
                    psize = r.font.size.pt if r.font.size else psize
                    if r.font.color and r.font.color.type is not None:
                        pcolor = r.font.color.rgb
                if psize is None:
                    continue
                if psize < min_font:
                    problems.append(f"slide {idx}: font {psize}pt < {min_font} in '{ptxt[:30]}'")
                # contrast: resolve panel behind this textbox, else slide bg
                panel_bg = None
                for other in shapes:
                    if other is shape or not other.has_text_frame:
                        continue
                    ox, oy, ow, oh = _in(other.left), _in(other.top), _in(other.width), _in(other.height)
                    if x >= ox - 0.02 and y >= oy - 0.02 and x + w <= ox + ow + 0.02 and y + h <= oy + oh + 0.02:
                        try:
                            of = other.fill
                            if of.type is not None and of.type == 1:
                                panel_bg = of.fore_color.rgb
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                bg_use = panel_bg or bg
                if pcolor is not None and bg_use is not None:
                    L1, L2 = _lum(*[c for c in pcolor]), _lum(*[c for c in bg_use])
                    ratio = (max(L1, L2) + 0.05) / (min(L1, L2) + 0.05)
                    threshold = 3.0 if psize >= 18 else 4.5
                    if ratio < threshold:
                        problems.append(f"slide {idx}: contrast {ratio:.1f} < {threshold} '{ptxt[:25]}' ({pcolor} on {bg_use})")
                eff_w = max(0.1, w - 2 * 0.12)
                est_h = _est_lines(ptxt, eff_w, psize) * psize * LINE_H / 72
                if est_h > h * 1.12:
                    problems.append(f"slide {idx}: overflow '{ptxt[:30]}' est {est_h:.2f}in > box {h:.2f}in")
    if problems:
        print(f"{len(problems)} problem(s):")
        for p in problems:
            print("  -", p)
        return f"FAIL {path}: {len(problems)} problem(s)"
    return f"OK {path}: no layout problems"


inject = ["tools"]
defaults = {}

apply = None

def _apply(ctx, config):
    t = ctx.get("tools")
    t.register("pptx.make_deck",
               {"description": "Build a .pptx from a JSON spec {out, title, slides:[{kind,title,cards,process,compare,chart,takeaway,closing}]}. Applies the verified grid/palette rules.",
                "args": {"spec": "JSON string or object"}},
               make_deck, kind="edit")
    t.register("pptx.check_deck",
               {"description": "Check a .pptx for overflow, overlap, min font, and WCAG contrast. Returns OK or a list of problems.",
                "args": {"path": "file path"}},
               check_deck, kind="read")

# patch inject/apply for the plugin API
globals()["inject"] = ["tools"]
globals()["apply"] = _apply

"""pptx plugin: make_deck + check_deck tools built on the lessons in
.agents/skills/pptx/SKILL.md (grid, verified palette, WCAG contrast,
overflow estimation, footer zone).

make_deck spec (JSON string or object):
{
  "out": "deck-lab/mydeck.pptx",        # required
  "title": "Deck Title",                # shown in footers
  "theme": {"font": "Liberation Sans", "palette overrides..."},
  "slides": [
     {"kind": "title"|"cards"|"process"|"compare"|"chart"|"takeaway"|"closing",
      "kicker": "...", "heading": "...", "subtitle": "...",
      "items": [...] , "data": [{"label","value","note","frac"}],
      "left": {...}, "right": {...}, "band": "...", "page": n}
  ]
}
Layouts (16:9, 0.5in margins, content top 1.95in, footer zone >= 7.0in):
 - title/closing: dark slide, 44pt heading in a 2.0in box, rule bar
 - cards: N equal panels; big stat + caps label + 2-3 line description
 - process: numbered step rows (panel per step) + accent bold lead-in
 - compare: two panels with arrow between + dark takeaway band
 - chart: hand-rolled bars (rectangles), values inside tall bars / above short ones
"""
import json
import math
import os

from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt, Emu
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

# ---- verified palette (from skill) ----
DARK = RGBColor(0x1F, 0x2A, 0x44)
INK = RGBColor(0x2E, 0x34, 0x40)
MUTED = RGBColor(0x4A, 0x52, 0x60)
ACCENT = RGBColor(0xB5, 0x45, 0x0D)
ACCENT_L = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xB0, 0x7A)
SOFT = RGBColor(0xF4, 0xF6, 0xFA)
LINE = RGBColor(0xD8, 0xDE, 0xE9)
WHITE = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
FAINT = RGBColor(0xA8, 0xB4, 0xC8)
GRAY3 = RGBColor(0x6E, 0x78, 0x8C)
FONT = "Liberation Sans"
CW, CH = Inches(13.333), Inches(7.5)
CONTENT_TOP = 1.95
FOOTER_TOP = 7.0
EMU_IN = 914400


def _in(v):
    return float(v) / EMU_IN


# ---------- primitives ----------
def _blank(prs, bg=WHITE):
    s = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    s.background.fill.solid()
    s.background.fill.fore_color.rgb = bg
    return s


def _text(slide, x, y, w, h, run, size, color=INK, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT,
          anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP, bold=False, line=1.15):
    box = slide.shapes.add_textbox(x, y, w, h)
    tf = box.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.vertical_anchor = anchor
    tf.margin_left = tf.margin_right = tf.margin_top = tf.margin_bottom = 0
    paras = [run] if isinstance(run, str) else run
    first = True
    for p in paras:
        para = tf.paragraphs[0] if first else tf.add_paragraph()
        first = False
        para.alignment = align
        para.line_spacing = line
        if isinstance(p, str):
            segs = [(p, {})]
        elif isinstance(p, dict) and "segs" in p:
            segs, extra = p["segs"], p
            para.alignment = extra.get("align", align)
            para.space_after = Pt(extra.get("space_after", 0))
            para.space_before = Pt(extra.get("space_before", 0))
        else:
            segs = p
        for t, ov in segs:
            r = para.add_run()
            r.text = t
            r.font.name = ov.get("font", FONT)
            r.font.size = Pt(ov.get("size", size))
            r.font.bold = ov.get("bold", bold)
            r.font.color.rgb = ov.get("color", color)
    return box


def _panel(slide, x, y, w, h, fill=SOFT, line_color=LINE):
    shp = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, x, y, w, h)
    shp.fill.solid()
    shp.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill
    if line_color:
        shp.line.color.rgb = line_color
        shp.line.width = Pt(0.75)
    else:
        shp.line.fill.background()
    try:
        shp.adjustments[0] = 0.08
    except Exception:
        pass
    shp.shadow.inherit = False
    return shp


def _rule(slide, x, y, w, color=ACCENT, h=0.07):
    bar = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, x, y, Inches(w), Inches(h))
    bar.fill.solid()
    bar.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    bar.line.fill.background()
    bar.shadow.inherit = False
    return bar


def _title_bar(slide, kicker, heading):
    _text(slide, Inches(0.5), Inches(0.42), Inches(9), Inches(0.35),
          kicker.upper(), 13, color=INK, bold=True)
    _text(slide, Inches(0.5), Inches(0.75), Inches(10), Inches(0.9),
          heading, 28, color=DARK, bold=True)
    _rule(slide, Inches(0.5), Inches(1.55), 1.6)
    return Inches(CONTENT_TOP)


def _footer(slide, deck_title, page):
    _text(slide, Inches(0.5), Inches(7.05), Inches(6), Inches(0.3),
          deck_title, 10, color=MUTED)
    _text(slide, Inches(12.0), Inches(7.05), Inches(0.8), Inches(0.3),
          str(page), 10, color=MUTED, align=PP_ALIGN.RIGHT)


# ---------- slide builders ----------
def _slide_title(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs, DARK)
    _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(1.6), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.5),
          (spec.get("kicker") or "MINI-DECK").upper(), 15, color=ACCENT_L, bold=True)
    _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(2.0), Inches(11.5), Inches(2.0),
          spec.get("heading", "Untitled"), 44, color=WHITE, bold=True)
    if spec.get("subtitle"):
        _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(4.1), Inches(8.5), Inches(1.2),
               spec["subtitle"], 18, color=FAINT, line=1.35)
    _rule(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(5.6), 2.2, color=ACCENT_L)
    if spec.get("foot"):
        _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(5.1), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.5),
               spec["foot"], 14, color=FAINT)


def _slide_closing(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs, DARK)
    _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(2.2), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.85),
          spec.get("heading", "Remember this"), 44, color=WHITE, bold=True)
    _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(3.4), Inches(10.5), Inches(1.0),
          spec.get("subtitle", ""), 18, color=FAINT, line=1.4)
    _rule(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(4.75), 2.2, color=ACCENT_L)
    if spec.get("foot"):
        _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(5.1), Inches(11.5), Inches(0.5),
               spec["foot"], 14, color=FAINT)


def _slide_cards(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs)
    top = _title_bar(s, spec.get("kicker", "Overview"), spec.get("heading", ""))
    items = spec.get("items", [])
    n = max(1, len(items))
    gap = 0.31
    total_w = 10.3
    cw_ = (total_w - (n - 1) * gap) / n
    x0 = 0.5
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        x = x0 + i * (cw_ + gap)
        _panel(s, Inches(x), top + Inches(0.15), Inches(cw_), Inches(3.7))
        if it.get("stat"):
            _text(s, Inches(x + 0.25), top + Inches(0.5), Inches(cw_ - 0.5), Inches(0.5),
                  it["stat"], 28, color=ACCENT, bold=True)
            _text(s, Inches(x + 0.25), top + Inches(1.15), Inches(cw_ - 0.5), Inches(0.5),
                  (it.get("label") or "").upper(), 13, color=INK, bold=True)
            dy = 1.9
        else:
            _text(s, Inches(x + 0.25), top + Inches(0.5), Inches(cw_ - 0.5), Inches(0.5),
                  it.get("label", ""), 20, color=DARK, bold=True)
            dy = 1.1
        if it.get("desc"):
            _text(s, Inches(x + 0.25), top + Inches(dy), Inches(cw_ - 0.5), Inches(1.8),
                  it["desc"], 13.5, color=MUTED, line=1.3)
    _footer(s, deck_title, page)


def _slide_process(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs)
    top = _title_bar(s, spec.get("kicker", "Process"), spec.get("heading", ""))
    items = spec.get("items", [])
    n = max(1, len(items))
    step_h = min(1.25, 4.4 / n)
    step_gap = 0.18
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        y = top + 0.15 + i * (step_h + step_gap)
        _panel(s, Inches(0.5), Inches(y), Inches(10.3), Inches(step_h))
        _text(s, Inches(0.9), Inches(y + 0.18), Inches(2.6), Inches(0.6),
              f"{i + 1}.  {it.get('label', '')}", 17, color=DARK, bold=True)
        if it.get("desc"):
            _text(s, Inches(3.7), Inches(y + 0.22), Inches(6.8), Inches(0.65),
                  it["desc"], 13.5, color=INK, line=1.25)
    if spec.get("band"):
        yb = top + 0.15 + n * step_h + (n) * step_gap + 0.15
        _text(s, Inches(0.5), Inches(yb), Inches(10.3), Inches(0.55),
              [
                  {"segs": [(spec["band"].split("::")[0], {"bold": True, "color": ACCENT}),
                             ("::" if "::" in spec["band"] else "", {"color": INK}),
                             (spec["band"].split("::", 1)[1] if "::" in spec["band"] else "", {"color": INK})]},
              ], 15, line=1.3)
    _footer(s, deck_title, page)


def _slide_compare(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs)
    top = _title_bar(s, spec.get("kicker", "Compare"), spec.get("heading", ""))
    left = spec.get("left", {})
    right = spec.get("right", {})
    for side, panel_x in ((left, 0.5), (right, 5.9)):
        _panel(s, Inches(panel_x), top + Inches(0.1), Inches(4.9), Inches(3.6), fill=SOFT)
        _text(s, Inches(panel_x + 0.35), top + Inches(0.45), Inches(4.2), Inches(0.5),
               side.get("label", ""), 18, color=DARK, bold=True)
        paras = []
        for d in side.get("descs", []):
            paras.append({"segs": [(d, {"color": INK})], "space_after": 8})
        if paras:
            _text(s, Inches(panel_x + 0.35), top + Inches(1.0), Inches(4.2), Inches(2.4),
                  paras, 14, line=1.35)
    arrow = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RIGHT_ARROW, Inches(5.42), top + Inches(1.6),
                               Inches(0.5), Inches(0.7))
    arrow.fill.solid()
    arrow.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT
    arrow.line.fill.background()
    arrow.shadow.inherit = False
    if spec.get("band"):
        band = _panel(s, Inches(0.5), top + Inches(3.95), Inches(10.3), Inches(0.75), fill=DARK)
        _text(s, Inches(0.85), top + Inches(4.12), Inches(9.6), Inches(0.55),
               spec["band"], 15, color=WHITE, bold=True, anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE)
    _footer(s, deck_title, page)


def _slide_chart(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs)
    top = _title_bar(s, spec.get("kicker", "Data"), spec.get("heading", ""))
    cx0, cy0, pw, ph = 0.9, top + 0.45, 6.6, 3.5
    _panel(s, Inches(cx0 - 0.3), Inches(cy0 - 0.35), Inches(pw + 0.6), Inches(ph + 0.7))
    _text(s, Inches(cx0 - 0.1), Inches(cy0 - 0.28), Inches(pw), Inches(0.3),
          spec.get("chart_title", "Values"), 11, color=INK)
    axis = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(cx0), Inches(cy0 + ph),
                              Inches(pw), Pt(1.5))
    axis.fill.solid()
    axis.fill.fore_color.rgb = MUTED
    axis.line.fill.background()
    axis.shadow.inherit = False
    data = spec.get("data", [])
    n = max(1, len(data))
    bw, gap = (pw / n) * 0.68, (pw / n) * 0.32
    for i, d in enumerate(data):
        frac = max(0.05, min(0.9, float(d.get("frac", 0.5))))
        bh = int(ph * frac * 914400)
        x = cx0 + i * (bw + gap)
        b = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, Inches(x), Inches(cy0 + ph - bh / 914400),
                               Inches(bw), Emu(bh))
        b.fill.solid()
        b.fill.fore_color.rgb = DARK if frac >= 0.5 else (ACCENT if frac < 0.5 and i % 2 == 1 else GRAY3)
        b.line.fill.background()
        b.shadow.inherit = False
        val = str(d.get("value", ""))
        if bh >= Inches(0.55):
            _text(s, Inches(x), Inches(cy0 + ph - bh / 914400 + 0.08), Inches(bw), Inches(0.4),
                  val, 14, color=WHITE, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        else:
            _text(s, Inches(x), Inches(cy0 + ph - bh / 914400 - 0.4), Inches(bw), Inches(0.4),
                  val, 14, color=INK, bold=True, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        _text(s, Inches(x), Inches(cy0 + ph + 0.08), Inches(bw), Inches(0.4),
               d.get("label", ""), 12, color=MUTED, align=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    if spec.get("caption"):
        _text(s, Inches(cx0), Inches(cy0 + ph + 0.62), Inches(pw), Inches(0.35),
               spec["caption"], 11, color=MUTED)
    # right panel
    _panel(s, Inches(8.1), top + Inches(0.1), Inches(4.7), Inches(3.6), fill=SOFT)
    _text(s, Inches(8.4), top + Inches(0.4), Inches(4.1), Inches(0.5),
          spec.get("note_label", "Read the data"), 18, color=DARK, bold=True)
    tips = spec.get("notes", [])
    yy = top + 1.05
    for t in tips[:3]:
        dot = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.OVAL, Inches(8.45), Inches(yy + 0.08),
                                 Inches(0.14), Inches(0.14))
        dot.fill.solid()
        dot.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT
        dot.line.fill.background()
        dot.shadow.inherit = False
        _text(s, Inches(8.75), Inches(yy), Inches(3.9), Inches(0.6), t, 13, color=INK, line=1.2)
        yy += 0.75
    _footer(s, deck_title, page)


def _slide_takeaway(prs, spec, deck_title, page):
    s = _blank(prs)
    top = _title_bar(s, spec.get("kicker", "Key point"), spec.get("heading", ""))
    band = _panel(s, Inches(0.5), top + Inches(0.3), Inches(10.3), Inches(1.1), fill=DARK)
    _text(s, Inches(0.85), top + Inches(0.45), Inches(9.6), Inches(0.8),
          spec.get("band", spec.get("subtitle", "")), 16, color=WHITE, bold=True,
          anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE, line=1.3)
    if spec.get("points"):
        yy = top + 1.75
        for p in spec["points"]:
            dot = s.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.OVAL, Inches(0.9), Inches(yy + 0.08),
                                     Inches(0.14), Inches(0.14))
            dot.fill.solid()
            dot.fill.fore_color.rgb = ACCENT
            dot.line.fill.background()
            dot.shadow.inherit = False
            _text(s, Inches(1.25), Inches(yy), Inches(9.4), Inches(0.5), p, 14, color=INK, line=1.2)
            yy += 0.6
    _footer(s, deck_title, page)


BUILDERS = {
    "title": _slide_title,
    "closing": _slide_closing,
    "cards": _slide_cards,
    "process": _slide_process,
    "compare": _slide_compare,
    "chart": _slide_chart,
    "takeaway": _slide_takeaway,
}


# ---------- tool: make_deck ----------
def make_deck(session, args):
    spec = args if isinstance(args, dict) else json.loads(args)
    out = spec.get("out") or "deck-lab/unnamed.pptx"
    deck_title = spec.get("title", out)
    prs = Presentation()
    prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height = CW, CH
    for i, s in enumerate(spec.get("slides", []), 1):
        kind = s.get("kind", "cards")
        page = s.get("page", i if kind not in ("title", "closing") else None)
        if kind in ("title", "closing"):
            BUILDERS[kind](prs, s, deck_title, i)
        elif page:
            BUILDERS.get(kind, _slide_cards)(prs, s, deck_title, page)
        else:
            BUILDERS.get(kind, _slide_cards)(prs, s, deck_title, i)
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out) or ".", exist_ok=True)
    prs.save(out)
    return f"saved {out} with {len(prs.slides._sldIdLst)} slides"


# ---------- tool: check_deck ----------
AVG_CHAR_PT = 0.55
LINE_H = 1.35


def _est_lines(text, box_w_in, size_pt):
    if not text:
        return 0
    cpl = max(1, int(box_w_in * 72 / (size_pt * AVG_CHAR_PT)))
    lines = 0
    for raw in text.split("\n"):
        lines += max(1, -(-len(raw) // cpl)) if len(raw) > 0.95 * cpl else 1
    return lines


def _lum(r, g, b):
    def f(c):
        c /= 255
        return c / 12.92 if c <= 0.04045 else ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4
    R, G, B = f(r), f(g), f(b)
    return 0.2126 * R + 0.7152 * G + 0.0722 * B


def check_deck(session, args):
    path = args if isinstance(args, str) else args.get("path")
    min_font = 10
    prs = Presentation(path)
    sw, sh = _in(prs.slide_width), _in(prs.slide_height)
    problems = []
    for idx, slide in enumerate(prs.slides, 1):
        bg = None
        try:
            f = slide.background.fill
            if f.type is not None and f.type == 1:
                bg = f.fore_color.rgb
        except Exception:
            pass
        shapes = list(slide.shapes)
        for shape in shapes:
            x, y, w, h = _in(shape.left), _in(shape.top), _in(shape.width), _in(shape.height)
            if not shape.has_text_frame:
                continue
            tf = shape.text_frame
            text = tf.text
            if not text.strip():
                continue
            if x < -0.01 or y < -0.01 or x + w > sw + 0.01 or y + h > sh + 0.01:
                problems.append(f"slide {idx}: out of bounds '{text[:30]}'")
            is_footer = y >= FOOTER_TOP - 0.05 and len(text) < 60
            if not is_footer and y + h > FOOTER_TOP:
                problems.append(f"slide {idx}: crosses footer '{text[:30]}' (bottom {y + h:.2f})")
            # shape-vs-shape overlap among textboxes
            for other in shapes:
                if other is shape or not other.has_text_frame:
                    continue
                ox, oy = _in(other.left), _in(other.top)
                ow, oh = _in(other.width), _in(other.height)
                # only flag if both are "body" textboxes that meaningfully intersect
                if ox < x + w and ox + ow > x and oy < y + h and oy + oh > y:
                    ix = max(0.0, min(x + w, ox + ow) - max(x, ox))
                    iy = max(0.0, min(y + h, oy + oh) - max(y, oy))
                    if ix > 0.15 and iy > 0.15:
                        problems.append(f"slide {idx}: overlap '{text[:20]}' x '{other.text_frame.text[:20]}'")
            for para in tf.paragraphs:
                if not para.text.strip():
                    continue
                ptxt = para.text
                psize = None
                pcolor = None
                for r in para.runs:
                    psize = r.font.size.pt if r.font.size else psize
                    if r.font.color and r.font.color.type is not None:
                        pcolor = r.font.color.rgb
                if psize is None:
                    continue
                if psize < min_font:
                    problems.append(f"slide {idx}: font {psize}pt < {min_font} in '{ptxt[:30]}'")
                # contrast: resolve panel behind this textbox, else slide bg
                panel_bg = None
                for other in shapes:
                    if other is shape or not other.has_text_frame:
                        continue
                    ox, oy, ow, oh = _in(other.left), _in(other.top), _in(other.width), _in(other.height)
                    if x >= ox - 0.02 and y >= oy - 0.02 and x + w <= ox + ow + 0.02 and y + h <= oy + oh + 0.02:
                        try:
                            of = other.fill
                            if of.type is not None and of.type == 1:
                                panel_bg = of.fore_color.rgb
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                bg_use = panel_bg or bg
                if pcolor is not None and bg_use is not None:
                    L1, L2 = _lum(*[c for c in pcolor]), _lum(*[c for c in bg_use])
                    ratio = (max(L1, L2) + 0.05) / (min(L1, L2) + 0.05)
                    threshold = 3.0 if psize >= 18 else 4.5
                    if ratio < threshold:
                        problems.append(f"slide {idx}: contrast {ratio:.1f} < {threshold} '{ptxt[:25]}' ({pcolor} on {bg_use})")
                eff_w = max(0.1, w - 2 * 0.12)
                est_h = _est_lines(ptxt, eff_w, psize) * psize * LINE_H / 72
                if est_h > h * 1.12:
                    problems.append(f"slide {idx}: overflow '{ptxt[:30]}' est {est_h:.2f}in > box {h:.2f}in")
    if problems:
